file: # splittable: YES/NO — determines whether a file can be split into multiple map tasks
# compression_ratio: local_size / hdfs_size (>1 means compression saves space)
#   gzip (.gz):  NOT splittable — MapReduce treats entire file as 1 split
#   bzip2 (.bz2): SPLITTABLE — bzip2 block boundaries are seekable
#   Snappy:      NOT splittable as raw file (splittable inside SequenceFile/ORC)
#   ORC/Parquet: SPLITTABLE at column stripe boundaries
